# Core Summary
A tense interrogation scene in a coldly lit room where an experienced detective psychologically pressures a suspect. The clip uses a multi-shot progression (3 shots) to escalate tension within 10 seconds. Shot 1 establishes the detective's dominance with his opening line. Shot 2 focuses on the physical action of sliding the photo and the suspect's deflection. Shot 3 delivers the climax with the detective's final assertion and a subtle reaction.

# Scene
[shot1][00:00-00:03] Interrogation room, cold white fluorescent overhead lighting casting harsh shadows. Metal table surface reflects the light, slightly scratched. An ashtray sits centrally with a burning cigarette emitting thin smoke.
[shot2][00:03-00:06] Environment identical to shot1, camera angle lowers to table level, depth of field shallow focusing on the table surface and hands.
[shot3][00:06-00:10] Environment identical to shot1, lighting highlights the metal texture and smoke particles in the air, background slightly blurred.

# Subjects Description
<ID_A> (Old Detective)
- Gender: Male
- Race/Ethnicity: East Asian
- Age: Middle-aged to Elderly
- Appearance features: Deep wrinkles, heavy bags under eyes, wearing a wrinkled dark suit, tie slightly loose.
- Vocal Characteristics: Deep, gravelly voice, slow and deliberate pacing, heavy emphasis on each word.

<ID_B> (Suspect)
- Gender: Male
- Race/Ethnicity: East Asian
- Age: Young Adult to Middle-aged
- Appearance features: Clean-shaven or light stubble, wearing casual dark clothing, arms crossed, expression of hidden contempt.
- Vocal Characteristics: Lighter tone, casual, slightly mocking, faster pace than ID_A.

# Dynamic Narrative
[shot1][00:00-00:03] Low angle medium shot. <ID_A> sits left, facing right. <ID_B> sits right, facing left. Cold light hits <ID_A>'s face. <ID_A> taps fingers slowly on the metal table. Smoke rises from the ashtray between them.
<ID_A> (slow, heavy) says: [00:00-00:03]「你知道我做这行多少年了吗。」

[shot2][00:03-00:06] Low angle close-up on the table surface. <ID_A>'s hand slides a photograph across the metal towards <ID_B>. The photo scrapes softly against the metal. <ID_B>'s eyes glance down then quickly shift away.
<ID_B> (casual, mocking) says: [00:03-00:06]「跟我有关系吗。」

[shot3][00:06-00:10] Extreme close-up on <ID_A>'s face, low angle. He does not look up, mouth moves slightly. The smoke drifts across the frame. Light reflects sharply in his eyes.
<ID_A> (calm, absolute) says: [00:06-00:10]「有。因为我从没输过。」

# Style, Color & Aesthetics
Visual Style: Crime Thriller / Film Noir influence.
Color Palette: Cold whites, steel grays, deep blacks, muted skin tones.
Lighting: High contrast chiaroscuro, harsh overhead fluorescent, metallic reflections.
Texture: Gritty, realistic, emphasis on metal and smoke details.
Quality: High definition, cinematic depth of field.

# Atmosphere & Emotion
Atmosphere: Oppressive, tense, psychological pressure.
Emotion: Dominance vs. Defiance, underlying threat, cold calculation.
